source.policy: B2W2 Castelia habitat evidence, not a reproduction of its original access route. Project northern city garden placement, levels 22-24 and weights 60/40. Pidove and Petilil only; no sewer, season, Surf, story gate or evolution implied.

Species habitat reference only. Project levels 22-24 and weights 40/60 support the existing level-25 travel party. Initial supported subset: Rattata and Drowzee. Abra and Ditto are not claimed as implemented here. No radio, time, Surf or fishing unlocks.

Cinnabar regional species reference from authored ENC-035 (FireRed Mansion records 31417 and 31419). Project outdoor habitat adaptation, not an original Mansion encounter or an implemented Mansion map. Levels 22-24 and weights 60/40 are project tuning for the level-25 cap. Two optional outskirts grass patches only; no sea encounters, story locks or gifts. Koffing and Magmar remain excluded.

Day walking habitat reference with a supported-species project subset. Rattata and Spearow are shared day references; Ekans represents the SoulSilver side. Hoppip and Zubat are excluded from this day-only runtime subset. Levels 22-24 and weights 50/30/20 are project tuning for the existing level-25 travel party. No rain battle rule, radio, headbutt, fishing, gift or story lock is implied.

1F cave walking habitat reference with the currently supported Zubat, Geodude and Onix only. Levels 23-25 and weights 45/45/10 are project tuning for the existing level-25 travel party. Sandshrew is not yet in the runtime roster. No Surf, fishing, B1F, B2F, Friday encounter or story lock is implied.

Day walking habitat reference with a supported-species project subset. Rattata represents HeartGold and SoulSilver while Ekans represents the SoulSilver side. Bellsprout, Mareep and Hoppip are not yet in the runtime roster. Levels 23-25 and weights 70/30 are project tuning for the existing level-25 travel party. No version choice, radio, night, Surf, fishing, swarm, gift or story lock is implied.

Day walking habitat reference with the currently supported Rattata, Spearow and Ekans only. Levels 22-24 and weights 45/35/20 are project tuning for the level-25 travel party, not original rates. Sandshrew and version selection are excluded. Optional grass branches only; no item, trainer, Surf or story lock is implied.

Route 10 north and south share a supported day-walking project pool of Rattata, Spearow and Ekans. Levels 23-25 and weights 40/35/25 are project tuning, not original rates. Optional grass branches only. Power Plant water, fishing, Surf, version selection and story gates remain unavailable.

Rock Tunnel cave habitat reference using supported Zubat, Geodude, Machop and Onix. Levels 23-25 and weights 40/35/15/10 are project tuning. Encounters are limited to B1F optional echo loops so the marked main passage remains safe. No Flash requirement, item, fixed encounter or story gate is implied.

Combined HeartGold and SoulSilver daytime walking habitat using the currently supported Caterpie, Metapod, Weedle, Kakuna and Zubat. Paras is not yet in the runtime roster. Levels 22-24 and weights 30/17/30/18/5 are project tuning for the existing travel party, not original rates. Encounters use optional southern-loop grass while the marked main road remains safe. No version choice, night, radio, Headbutt, Surf, fishing, gift, Farfetchd puzzle, shrine event or story lock is implied.
